variants.name: npm install で入れる・名前を付ける

tool:
# 予約サイトの確かめ
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: 部品を入れる
        run: npm install
      - name: テスト
        run: npm test
      - name: 社内の台帳に届くか確かめる
        run: curl -fsS https://intra.city.example/health
label:

      - name: 社内の台帳に届くか確かめる
        run: curl -fsS https://intra.city.example/health

variants.name: ラベルを縦に書く・手順の前に node を準備する

tool:
# 予約サイトの確かめ
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
      - name: 社内の台帳に届くか確かめる
        run: curl -fsS https://intra.city.example/health
label:
# 予約サイトの確かめ
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on:
      - self-hosted
      - city-net
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
      - name: 社内の台帳に届くか確かめる
        run: curl -fsS https://intra.city.example/health
